question: Among molecules that contain at least one bond between a phosphorus atom and a nitrogen atom, what percentage of their atoms are chlorine, and for each such molecule, indicate whether it is carcinogenic?

prediction.sql:
WITH pn_mols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005
  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN connected AS c1 ON b.XCL_004 = c1.XCL_009
  JOIN connected AS c2 ON b.XCL_004 = c2.XCL_009 AND c1.XCL_007 <> c2.XCL_007
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON c1.XCL_007 = a1.XCL_001
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON c2.XCL_007 = a2.XCL_001
  WHERE (a1.XCL_003 = 'p' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'n')
     OR (a1.XCL_003 = 'n' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'p')
)
SELECT
  m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'cl' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS chlorine_percentage,
  m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT XCL_005 FROM pn_mols)
GROUP BY m.XCL_010, m.XCL_011
ORDER BY m.XCL_010

WITH pn_mols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005 AS mol
  FROM connected c1
  JOIN atom a1 ON c1.XCL_007 = a1.XCL_001
  JOIN connected c2 ON c1.XCL_009 = c2.XCL_009 AND c1.XCL_007 <> c2.XCL_007
  JOIN atom a2 ON c2.XCL_007 = a2.XCL_001
  JOIN bond b ON c1.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
  WHERE (a1.XCL_003 = 'p' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'n')
     OR (a1.XCL_003 = 'n' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'p')
)
SELECT m.XCL_010 AS molecule,
       CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'cl' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS cl_percentage,
       m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT mol FROM pn_mols)
GROUP BY m.XCL_010, m.XCL_011
ORDER BY m.XCL_010;

eligibility_lowering.pre_lowering_sql:
WITH pn_mols AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.XCL_005
  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN connected AS c1 ON b.XCL_004 = c1.XCL_009
  JOIN connected AS c2 ON b.XCL_004 = c2.XCL_009 AND c1.XCL_007 <> c2.XCL_007
  JOIN atom AS a1 ON c1.XCL_007 = a1.XCL_001
  JOIN atom AS a2 ON c2.XCL_007 = a2.XCL_001
  WHERE (a1.XCL_003 = 'p' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'n')
     OR (a1.XCL_003 = 'n' AND a2.XCL_003 = 'p')
)
SELECT
  m.XCL_010 AS molecule_id,
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.XCL_003 = 'cl' THEN a.XCL_001 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.XCL_001) AS chlorine_percentage,
  m.XCL_011 AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
WHERE m.XCL_010 IN (SELECT XCL_005 FROM pn_mols)
GROUP BY m.XCL_010, m.XCL_011
ORDER BY m.XCL_010
